newsitem.title: USA: Sony sues U.S. cos over counterfeit games.
newsitem.headline: Sony sues U.S. cos over counterfeit games.

text.p: Sony Interactive Entertainment said Friday it has filed several suits against U.S. and Canadian companies it accuses of selling counterfeit and gray market versions of Sony's PlayStation games.

The action comes after a recent amendment expanded the Racketeering Influenced and Corrupt Organization Act to permit suits against groups dealing in pirated intellectual property, particularly counterfeit goods or goods bearing counterfeit marks, Sony said.
The lawsuits seek to impound infringing products in addition to recovery of damages.
Sony said the companies named are in New York, Toronto, Miami and Orange County, California. They include National Console Support, Super Collector and Video Games Plus, Sony said.
